entities.mention: State Farm emergency interim rate filing 2025

edges.dst_mention: State Farm emergency interim rate filing 2025
edges.span: State Farm has requested emergency rate increases, effective May 1, 2025: 22% for Non-Tenant homeowners, 15% for Tenants (Renters), 15% for Tenants (Condominium Unitowners), and 38% for Rental Dwelling.
